MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_ABYSSAL_NIGHTM: Translucent and nearly invisible in darkness. Only the eyes and inner organs glow. It hangs motionless until it snaps shut toward the player.
A silence-breaker creature. Fear comes from route cost and acoustic warning before contact.
Deep-sea fish really can be translucent.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_BUILDER_: A metal chassis threaded with organic tubing. It drags materials toward construction points. It does not attack unless disturbed. Under threat it emits a high-frequency screech and summons a Defender.
The first drone encounter. Uncertainty is scarier than ABRIR hostility.
A product of the Atlas-6 Seed Program.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_COURIER_: A small fast drone. It delivers barter capsules to beacons. No direct interaction. It is simply logistics in motion.
Atmosphere pass: Atlas-6 is not a character, but a system.
A product of the Atlas-6 Seed Program.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DEFENDER: A combat drone that reacts to the Builder's alarm. Aggressive. Guards construction zones and the Atlas-6 core.
Threat response when the player disrupts builder activity.
A product of the Atlas-6 Seed Program.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_ATLAS_DREADNOU: A biomechanical hybrid of crab and industrial excavator. Atlas AI towers on its back throw cutting arcs. It guards the core and turns shutdown into a pressure-route fight.
Core guardian. Demands tactics, route control, and the full arsenal.
Biomechanical hybrids are an Atlas-6 concept, not natural fauna.

MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_GLASSWORM_ROLE: Route distortion and sonar uncertainty. Its body turns visibility into a temporary decision cost.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_GLASSWORM_SCIE: Filter-feeders are real: salps, pyrosomes. This is a giant extrapolation.

MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_HA: Shelves, wreck lanes, pressure-current routes (80-700 m)
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_RO: Scale and route-risk signal. It marks currents, hides silhouettes, and can turn a return path expensive.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_REEF_GLIDER_SC: Ray-like lift surfaces are plausible. The debris load is a HECTON-8 stress adaptation, not reef decoration.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_DE: A giant organism half-grown into the rock. Only the snout and a pair of limbs protrude. It seems asleep. If you approach, the head turns slowly. It does not attack, but the stare freezes you.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_RO: Psychological barrier. The player never knows whether it will wake.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_ROOT_DRAGON_SC: Organisms fused into substrate are real: sea lilies, ascidians.

MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_TERMITE_WORM_S: Burrowing worms are real, including Eunice aphroditois.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_THERMAL_PHANTO: A translucent jelly-like creature that lives along the thermocline. Its tentacles burn and shove the player upward. Painful, but not lethal.
A marker that says: farther ahead is dangerous, upgrade REQUERIDO.
The thermocline is real. Jellyfish with thermal lenses are speculative.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_TITAN_LEVIATHA: A massive eel with metallized scales and a hydraulic jaw. Glowing discharges run along its spine. It patrols slowly and emits a low-frequency hum.

Primary apex predator. Visible from afar. Builds anticipation.
Giant eels are real. Electric organs are real.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_DES: A huge ray with a long tail-generator. It guards valuable wreckage. It does not kill outright, but it can stun with a discharge.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_HAB: Western shelf, near the ruins (100–800 m)
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_NIG: Patrols actively at night. More aggressive.
MOCK_ES_ES_FAUNA_CREATURE_VOLT_MANTA_ROL: Guards resources. Forces the player to think instead of just shooting.
